verdict.rationale: No evidence describes any native mobile (iOS/Android) capability, e.g. NativeScript/Ionic-style native rendering; Angular is presented purely as a web/SSR framework with elements/animations/lazy-loading, none of which produce native mobile apps. missing for 10: any mention of native mobile compilation or integration (e.g., NativeScript, Capacitor), performance benchmarks on mobile devices, or first-party native app tooling.
